verdict.citation: `vec![method_with_action("load", ItemAction::Add, vec![])]` with `ItemAction::Modify` and `ItemAction::Reference` parent actions, plus the omitted-action cases using `MethodDeclaration::associated_function(...)` under `ItemAction::Reference`, each asserting `InvalidCatalogueState`; and the analogous `TypeEntry` and `InherentImplDeclV2` method cases.

validate_parent_forbids_method_spec_refs(
                ItemAction::Reference,
                &[method("load", ItemAction::Reference, vec![spec_ref("IN-01")])],
            )
            .is_err()

validate_parent_forbids_method_spec_refs(
                ItemAction::Delete,
                &[method("load", ItemAction::Delete, vec![spec_ref("IN-01")])],
            )
            .is_err()

assert_eq!(decl.action(), ItemAction::Add); ... assert_eq!(decl.action(), ItemAction::Modify); assert_ne!(decl.action(), ItemAction::Add); ... assert_eq!(method.action(), ItemAction::Add); ... assert_eq!(entry.action(), ItemAction::Modify); assert_eq!(entry.methods()[0].action(), ItemAction::Reference);
